title: Architecture, security and foundation
summary: Documented contracts, threat model, monorepo, Tauri shell, Rust crates, settings store, SQLite, policy engine and test scaffolding.
note: Code half passes on macOS, Windows and Linux. The gate stays open on design tokens and Windows/Linux performance numbers.

title: Production terminal
summary: PTY-backed shells, tabs and splits, shell integration, search, session restore, SSH, settings and themes.
note: Terminal view, tabs, splits, search, theme, restore, shell integration, links, settings, SSH and PowerShell are merged. Windows shells by hand, a performance re-check and the gate script remain.

title: Rust provider gateway and local AI
summary: OS keychain credentials, direct model adapters with streaming, a capability registry, routing baseline, local runtime detection.
note: Credentials, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible and Gemini adapters, the provider manager, Ollama and LM Studio detection, routing profiles, budgets and usage are merged. Model downloads and coding-agent account connections are not.

title: Native single-agent coding
summary: A Rust model and tool loop with Ask, Plan, Build, Debug and Review modes, context inspection, diff approvals and session history.
note: Agent loop, Agents view, diff approvals, project discovery, conversations, scoped memory, structured plans, the terminal tool and the egress preview are merged. Windows and Linux verification remains.

title: Workspaces, Git and editor
summary: Repository management, Git views, worktrees, project state, search and indexing, the editor and snapshots.
note: Git core and view, project state and the Board foundation are merged. The editor, indexing and remote editing are not started.

title: Native Factory orchestration
summary: Task DAG, manager and worker roles, leases, scheduling, isolated teams, Council orchestration and the Agent Inbox.
note: Plan materialisation, leased task runs, Council orchestration, the manager and worker hierarchy and the Agent Inbox are merged.

title: Verification, recovery and integration
summary: An independent verifier, bounded repair loops, snapshots with restore, and an integration pipeline with evidence reports.
note: Independent verification, the integrator with conflict preview and approval, and snapshots are merged.

title: Control plane, workers and agent APIs
summary: A durable background daemon, first-party remote workers, service registry, typed versioned APIs and headless multi-project control.

title: Routing, budgets, workflow and event engine
summary: Policy inheritance, model pools and fallbacks, cost dashboards, a scheduler, standing orders, event and webhook triggers, and a workflow builder.

title: Extensibility
summary: Extension API and host, MCP client and server, permissions, contribution docs, Linear, Jira, Asana, GitHub and GitLab adapters for the Board.

title: Design, platform and operational polish
summary: Full visual consistency, keyboard and accessibility work, onboarding, settings, platform quirks and performance targets.

title: Hardening and public release
summary: Security review, red-team tests, regression suite, crash and recovery drills, signed installers, updates and release-candidate acceptance.
